items.docs: Retrieves the list of ink strokes from an InkStrokeContainer. Each InkStroke contains point data, drawing attributes (color, size, pen tip shape), and bounding rectangle information.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Add an ink stroke

items.docs: Adds a new ink stroke to the InkStrokeContainer using InkStrokeBuilder. The stroke is created from a series of ink points with position, pressure, tilt, and timestamp data, combined with InkDrawingAttributes for visual styling.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get ink stroke details

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific ink stroke including its points, drawing attributes, and bounding rectangle.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Delete an ink stroke

items.docs: Deletes a specific ink stroke from the container using InkStroke.Selected and InkStrokeContainer.DeleteSelected methods.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Recognize handwriting from ink strokes

items.docs: Performs handwriting recognition on ink strokes using InkRecognizerContainer. RecognizeAsync. Returns a list of InkRecognitionResult candidates with recognized text alternatives ranked by confidence.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 List available ink recognizers

items.docs: Retrieves the list of installed handwriting recognizers using InkRecognizerContainer.GetRecognizers. Each recognizer supports a specific language and script for handwriting recognition.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get default drawing attributes

items.docs: Retrieves the default InkDrawingAttributes used for new strokes, including color, size, pen tip shape, transparency, and fit-to-curve settings.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Update default drawing attributes

items.docs: Updates the default InkDrawingAttributes for new strokes. Changes affect all subsequently created strokes.
